necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0) and a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73). Given the unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9) and concern for potential embolic events or hemodynamic instability, mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
